India A wins Tri-Series title with Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking innings

India A secured the tri-series title by defeating Sri Lanka A by 66 runs in the final. India A posted a formidable total of 377 for nine, largely due to a blistering 94 runs off 29 balls by Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. Sooryavanshi's innings included a half-century scored in just 11 balls, setting a new List A cricket record and surpassing the previous mark held by Kaushalya Weeraratne. Despite a strong effort from Sri Lanka A, India A's bowlers, including Yash Thakur, maintained pressure to clinch the victory. Sooryavanshi credited coach guidance for overcoming challenging conditions.
